concept.title: Why your coffee tastes better at altitude
concept.logline: A short explainer about extraction and water boiling point.
concept.cta: Try it next morning. Link in bio.
negative_rules: Do not claim medical or health effects of caffeine.
Do not disparage any brand of equipment.

claims.text: Water boils at lower temperatures at high altitude.
claims.snippet: Boiling point varies with atmospheric pressure.

approved_script.full_text: Coffee tastes different up here, and there is one reason. Water boils at a lower temperature, so your brew runs slightly cooler. Try a finer grind, the same ratio, and you taste the difference.
